walk_fixes.reported: founder, walking the creator wallet: "it is showing next 50% even without release it is showing in creator wallet transaction ... check same for new hybrid funding test campaign".
walk_fixes.data_layer_verdict: THE MONEY WAS NEVER WRONG. Read straight from production escrow_entries: New hybrid funding test, hybrid, fee ₹8,500 → T1 ₹2,125 RELEASED on signing, T2 ₹2,125 LOCKED trigger content_live, T3 ₹4,250 LOCKED trigger day_30_post_live. Same shape on all four signed collaborations, each splitting exactly to its fee. Nothing had been released early and nothing had reached her balance.
walk_fixes.cause: a display defect, and a serious one. GET /influencers/me/earnings returns locked_entries from `SELECT ee.*`, so the column is `tranche_number`. CreatorWalletScreen read `e.tranche`, which is undefined, so every row fell through to the default label and said "On signing" — including the 50%. Three quarters of her fee appeared to be due at signature.
walk_fixes.why_tests_missed_it: the fixture in creatorWallet.test.js invented `tranche: 2`, the field the screen happened to read, instead of copying the shape the server actually sends. The test proved the screen agreed with itself. The fixture now carries `tranche_number`; reverting the one-word fix makes that test fail, which was checked.
walk_fixes.fix: CreatorWalletScreen reads tranche_number. The copy function was already correct — "When your post goes live and the brand confirms it" for T2, "After your post has stayed live" for T3.
